security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; connect-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Visual git undo from your reflog
bundle.longDescription: Reads a reflog or git log you paste in, shows real diffs, and generates the safe undo command. Never executes git for you.
